name: @jsondeepl/cli
description: A CLI tool to translate JSON i18n files using the DeepL API — bring your own DeepL API key

scripts.release: pnpm run test && pnpm dlx changelogen@latest --release && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm run test && pnpm dlx changelogen@latest --release --major && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run test && pnpm dlx changelogen@latest --release --minor && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run test && pnpm dlx changelogen@latest --release --patch && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:types && vitest run --coverage
